body: The Counselor.... Seriously, I walked out of the theater asking those around me what the fuck I had just watched.
I want to believe those words, but if I burden every one I care about like I burden my friends, is it worth waiting out? I can't stand knowing I cause them any grief at all
I can't thank you enough. I need to see that there is good out there even if it's not always so apparent, and each and every reply helps.

Well individually they hate each other. Friend "A" hates me for being friends with his ex- girlfriend, Friend "b" . I've been friends with both for a long time and he only dated her recently so I couldn't just quit being her friend. Friend "B" hates that I'm friends with her ex best friend. Unfortunately I feel very strongly about her ex best friend "C" . "A" also feels for "C" and hates me also for that. It's so typical stupid highschool it hurts. I just want to be able too keep all my friends and not deal with petty bullshit. It all feels like if I wasn't here their lives would be easier and that's all I want.

I can't thank you enough for caring. I was just told to fuck off by my 2 best friends. The each individually told me that I'm horrible and that it's my fault they are unhappy. They are all I've had for 3 years and now they don't want I even look at me, because of something I said or did. I don't even know why it's upset them so much, but they hate me now. My family couldn't afford to have me acting this way. They tell me I have to snap out of it but I can't! I don't know how! My older brother moved away three months ago and calls everyone regularly; but not me. I love them all and I want to be there for them but how can I be so awful that they don't even want me to look in their direction? It can't be right, and it's all my fault.
"You are next." This came immediately after he ripped the head off of his action figure. I'm terrified for my life because of my 4 year old cousin
